guides.title: Make clips from a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link
guides.answer: Copy the link to a stream or video, paste it on Home and tap **Make clips**. Clip Factory finds the best moments for you.
steps: Copy the link from YouTube, Twitch or Kick.
Watch it work in **Jobs**. New clips wait for you in **Review**.

guides.title: Make clips from your own video file
guides.answer: You can make clips from a video file too. Tap **Pick a video** on Home, choose the file and tap **Make clips**. On a computer you can also drag the video onto the box.
steps: Tap the box and pick an MP4, MOV or WebM file (up to 5 GB). On a computer you can also drag the video from your folder and drop it on the box.

guides.title: Where is my job and how long does it take
guides.answer: Every link or video you add is one job. **Jobs** shows each one being made, step by step.
steps: Tap a job to watch its steps.
To stop it, tap **Stop job**. Clips already made are kept.

guides.title: My job failed
guides.answer: When a job fails, open it and tap **Try again**. It starts over from the beginning and uses the video it already saved.

guides.title: Delete a job
guides.answer: Tap the bin on a job in **Jobs**, or tap **Delete job** on its page. Clip Factory asks first and says what happens. A job still working stops first. Clips you kept or posted stay, and your posts stay up. Its clips waiting in Review go too only if you turn on **Also delete its clips in Review**. You can undo for 8 seconds.
steps: Tap the bin on the job, or tap **Select** to pick several (**Pick all failed** picks every failed one).

guides.title: Is anything running right now
guides.answer: **Jobs** shows what Clip Factory is making right now.
steps: Tap **Jobs** to see each job and how far along it is.

guides.title: What Upload does
guides.answer: **Upload** says yes to a clip. It goes up to every place you picked under **Upload to**, each with its own caption. Nothing is posted until you tap **Upload**, unless you turn on **Auto-posting** in Settings.
steps: Under **Upload to**, turn on each place you want.
Tap **Upload** to post it, or **Throw away** if you do not like it.

guides.title: Upload to many places at once
guides.answer: On each clip, **Upload to** shows every place that is set up, all ticked to start. It says **Your settings are on** (if not, tap **Use my settings**); then tap **Upload**. That is the only place picker: each ticked place gets its own row below for its words and options. A place that is not set up yet does not show; set it up in **Set up posting**.
steps: Under **Upload to**, tap a place to untick it if it should not go there.
If it does not say **Your settings are on**, tap **Use my settings**. Then tap **Upload**.

guides.where: Review › a clip › Use my settings
guides.title: Use my settings: your saved choices on every place
guides.answer: Every ticked place starts on your saved choices (never made for kids), TikTok too while your Mac posts TikTok, and your Mac posts with them. Just tap **Upload**. A paid partnership can't go through your Mac yet: untick TikTok, then post it in the TikTok app with its label, never with **Post with my Mac** or **Send these to my Mac**. With **Your Mac posts TikTok** off, tap **Use my settings**.
steps: It says **Your settings are on**. If not, tap **Use my settings**.

guides.where: Review › a clip › a place's row
guides.title: Change one place for one clip
guides.answer: Each ticked place has a row under **Use my settings**: tap it to change it for this clip. For a paid partnership, open **TikTok**, turn on **Commercial content**, tick **Branded content**. While your Mac posts TikTok, the row shows what it uses. It can't add that label yet: untick TikTok, then post it in the TikTok app with its label, not with **Post with my Mac** or **Send these to my Mac**.
steps: Tap a place's row, like **TikTok · caption and settings**.
Change what you want, then tap **Upload**.

guides.title: Change My settings
guides.answer: **My settings** are the choices **Use my settings** puts on a clip, one part per place, X too. They start at everyone can see it, comments, duets and stitches on, and never made for kids.
steps: Change a place. It saves at once.

guides.title: Turn on auto-posting
guides.answer: **Auto-posting** posts your oldest clips in **Review** by themselves, every few hours, to each place that is set up. TikTok goes through your Mac: turn on **Your Mac posts TikTok**. Campaign clips wait for your **Upload**: Content Rewards can't take clips from Clip Factory by itself yet. Test it first with **Practice**: it picks the clips, but sends nothing.
steps: Pick **Post every** and **Clips each time**. The line under them says how many clips a day that is.
Open **Test it first**. Tap **Practice run now** (nothing is sent), or **Private test run**: only you can see that clip, and it leaves **Review**.
Turn on **Post my clips by themselves**. It saves at once and says when the next one goes.
Don't want a clip to go up? Tap **Throw away** on it at least 8 seconds before its turn (that is how long **Undo** stays).

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Your Mac posts TikTok
guides.title: Let your Mac post your TikTok clips
keywords: my mac posts my tiktok clips
guides.answer: With **Your Mac posts TikTok** on, your Mac posts each TikTok clip for everyone. Each TikTok row in **Library** says what it does. **Didn't work**? Tap **Try again**. Not sure it posted? Look on your TikTok, then tap **It's on TikTok**. Paused? Tap **Start my Mac again**. Needs you? Tap **Open the stopped clip**. Holding clips? Tap **Let them go**. **Not on TikTok yet**? Tap **Post with my Mac**.
steps: Turn on **My Mac posts my TikTok clips**.
In **Library**, a clip says **Not on TikTok yet**? Tap **Post with my Mac**. Your Mac posts it right away.
Many clips not on TikTok yet? Tap **Send these to my Mac** here. They go one at a time, oldest first, one after each auto-posting run.
To stop it, turn the switch off. Your Mac stops at once.

guides.title: When auto-posting skips or fails a clip
guides.answer: **Waits for you** lists the clips auto-posting skips, each with why: tap **Open in Review** and **Upload** it yourself. **Didn't work** lists each post that did not go up, with what went wrong: tap **Try again** on it. The other places of that clip still post. **Recent** shows the last runs, with **Open** on each post.
steps: Under **Waits for you**, tap **Open in Review** on a clip, then **Upload** it yourself.
Under **Didn't work**, tap **Try again** on a post.
Under **Recent**, tap **Open** to see a post.

guides.title: Throw away a clip, and Undo
guides.answer: Tap **Throw away** on a clip you do not want. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** within 8 seconds and it comes back.
steps: Oops? Tap **Undo** on the message at the bottom, within 8 seconds.

guides.title: Change a caption before Upload
guides.answer: Each clip has its own caption for every place it goes. Change them on the clip in **Review** before you tap **Upload**. They save by themselves.
steps: Tap the place's row, like **TikTok · caption and settings**.

guides.title: What Chat went wild means
guides.answer: Each clip card says **Why:** it was picked. **Chat went wild** means the stream's chat suddenly went much faster than usual, or lots of people typed the same thing, right after this moment. Clip Factory only trusts it when something is also seen or heard there.
steps: **Chat went wild** means the viewers loved this moment.

guides.title: How many clips are waiting in Review
guides.answer: New clips wait in **Review** until you **Upload** or **Throw away** each one. With **Auto-posting** on, the oldest ones go up by themselves.
steps: Tap **Review** to check them one by one.

guides.title: Uploading a clip did not work
guides.answer: If one place did not work, the clip in **Library** says **Didn't work** with the reason, and that place has its own **Try again**.
steps: Find the place that says **Didn't work**.

guides.title: See how a clip is doing
guides.answer: Open a clip in **Library** to see its views, likes and comments on each place it was posted. A crown marks where it did best.
steps: Scroll to see each place and its numbers.

guides.title: How much money did I make?
guides.answer: Clip Factory only shows money a place reports. It never guesses from views and you never type money in. Tap **Money** in the menu. **All your money** at the top adds up your last 30 days from every place, Content Rewards too. **Monthly MRR** under it is the apps only. The list further down shows what YouTube says each posted clip earned. TikTok, Instagram and X don't share money with apps.
steps: Read **All your money** at the top. Each amount says whose numbers it is.
Scroll down to see what each clip earned.
keywords: how much money did i make

guides.title: What is MRR on the Money page?
guides.answer: MRR usually means subscriptions. Here it means the money the apps reported for your videos: **Monthly MRR** is the last 30 days, **Weekly MRR** the last 7, **Daily MRR** a normal day lately and **Yearly MRR** the monthly money kept up for a year (**at this pace**). Pick apps with the icons at the bottom right.
steps: Tap app icons in the bar at the bottom right to pick apps. **All** shows every app.
Tap **7 days**, **30 days**, **90 days** or **Year** to change the chart and the clip list.
Content Rewards money is not in MRR. It is in **All your money** at the top.

guides.title: Am I monetized yet?
guides.answer: Open **Settings › Posting › Money**. Each app's card has a pill: **Earning**, **In the program**, **Not yet**, **Goal reached**, **Can't tell** or **Not shared**, and bars like 812 / 1,000 subscribers. Only YouTube tells apps if you're in its paid program. **Goal reached** means you hit the numbers, but the app also checks things Clip Factory can't see.
steps: Look at each app's pill and bars.
Tap **More** to see the other goals.

guides.title: Let Clip Factory read your YouTube money
guides.answer: On the YouTube card, press **Allow money reading** and say yes on Google's page. A grown-up first adds the money permission in the same Google Cloud project (no new keys) and sets Publishing status to **In production**. Google's "unverified app" screen is normal: press **Advanced**, then **Continue**. Your connection and posts stay as they are.
steps: On the YouTube card, tap **First time? Steps for a grown-up** and do the steps.

guides.title: Where do I add my bank account to get paid?
guides.where: Settings › Posting › Money › Getting your money out
guides.answer: Each app pays you itself, so you add your bank or PayPal inside each app. **Get paid** shows the steps for each one. YouTube: **AdSense for YouTube**. Facebook and Instagram: Meta's **Payouts**. TikTok: your TikTok **Balance**. X: **Creator Studio**, through Stripe. Clip Factory never needs your bank details, and never asks for them.
steps: Tap the place that pays you.
Do its steps. You add your bank or PayPal on that app's own page.

guides.title: How much did I earn everywhere?
guides.answer: Tap **Money**. The first card, **All your money**, adds up the last 30 days from YouTube, Content Rewards and every other place that tells apps what you earn. **Total** is the biggest number. Each amount says whose numbers it is. TikTok, Instagram and X say **Not available**, never $0. Dollars and euros are never added together.
steps: Look at **All your money**, the first card.
Read **Total** and the places in it.
Under Content Rewards, read **Right now** and **Earned so far**.

guides.title: Why does it say Not available from TikTok?
guides.answer: TikTok, Instagram and X don't tell apps what you earn. So Clip Factory never guesses and never shows $0: it says **Not available from TikTok** and where to look. TikTok: **Profile**, then **Balance**. Instagram: **Professional dashboard**, then **Payouts**. X: **Creator Studio**. Facebook says **Coming soon** for now.
steps: Find the place in **All your money**.
Open that app and look there.
Money that went to your bank? Content Rewards doesn't tell apps. Look on Whop, **Balances**.

guides.title: How many views does this clip have
guides.answer: A clip's page in **Library** adds up its views from every place it was posted.
steps: Tap the clip to see its views.

live.text: This clip has {value} views so far. It does best on {platform}.

guides.title: How many clips have I posted
guides.answer: **Library** lists every clip you uploaded.

guides.title: Refresh numbers
guides.answer: Numbers update by themselves. To check now, open the clip and tap **Refresh numbers**. If it says **Next check in**, wait that long. Instagram and Facebook can take 2 days to settle.

guides.title: Star the best clips of the week
guides.answer: In **Library**, tap **This week** and star the clips that did best with **Best this week**. Clip Factory learns from your stars and makes more clips like them.
steps: Tap the star on your best clips (up to 10).

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › What it learned
guides.title: How Clip Factory learns from your clips
guides.answer: Every day Clip Factory checks your clips 7 days after posting. When some clips did much better than normal for that streamer, it looks at what they share and writes a short lesson. Lessons it is sure about go to your skills as **Prior learnings**. You can turn a lesson off or delete it in **What it learned**.
steps: Tap **Turn off** or **Delete** on a lesson you do not like.

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
guides.title: Follow streamers and see who is live
guides.answer: Open **Streamers I follow** and paste a streamer's link or type their name. If you type a name, tap **YouTube**, **Twitch** or **Kick**. Only follow streamers who said you can clip them: tap **Yes, they said I can**, then **Follow**. You see who is **LIVE** and when a stream ended or a new video came out. Making clips by itself comes in the next update; each video costs the same as one you paste.
steps: Paste a link or type a name, then tap **Find**.
Tap **Yes, they said I can**, then **Follow**.

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow › Twitch and Kick keys
guides.title: Twitch and Kick keys for live badges
guides.answer: YouTube works without keys. To see when Twitch or Kick streamers are live, a grown-up makes a free app on dev.twitch.tv or kick.com once and pastes its two keys in **Twitch and Kick keys**. Until then the streamer shows **Needs a grown-up**, but you can still follow them. Removing keys needs a long press.
steps: Ask a grown-up to tap **I am the grown-up** and follow the steps.

guides.title: Views on my best clip this week
guides.answer: **This week** in **Library** shows this week's clips, most views first.

live.text: Your best clip this week, "{hook}", has {value} views.

guides.title: Total views this week
guides.answer: **This week** in **Library** adds up the views of this week's clips.

live.text: This week's clips have {value} views together.

guides.title: How many clips this week
guides.answer: **This week** in **Library** lists the clips from this week.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
guides.title: Why my clip is private on TikTok
guides.answer: TikTok shows posts from Clip Factory privately until Clip Factory's TikTok app is approved. Your clip is posted, only you can see it for now, and its numbers come after.
steps: TikTok says **Uploaded privately**. That is normal for now.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
guides.title: TikTok won't let me press Save
guides.answer: On TikTok's app page, **Save** stays off until **App review** has its text and a video. Copy the review text in TikTok setup step 13, add a short screen video, then Save. Display API is not a product any more: add video.list and user.info.stats with **Add scopes** under Login Kit.
steps: Copy the review text into **App review**.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › YouTube
guides.title: Connect YouTube
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **YouTube**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect YouTube**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Instagram
guides.title: Connect Instagram
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **Instagram**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect Instagram**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Facebook
guides.title: Connect Facebook
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **Facebook**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect Facebook**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
guides.title: Connect TikTok
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **TikTok**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect TikTok**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › X
guides.title: Connect X
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **X**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect X**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.title: Which accounts are connected
guides.answer: **Set up posting** shows how many of the five places are ready, and a card for each one.

guides.title: Where did my setup list go?
guides.answer: The **Set up posting** list sits at the top right until each place is set up or skipped. When all five are done or skipped, it says **All set!** and goes away. It comes back by itself if a place you set up needs you again. You can always find every place, skip one, or bring back one you skipped in **Settings › Posting › Set up posting**.
steps: Find the place you skipped. It says **Skipped**.
Tap **Un-skip** to put it back on the list, or tap its card to set it up now.

guides.title: Which places start switched on
guides.answer: In **Where clips go** you pick the places that start switched on for new clips. On each clip you can still turn places on or off under **Upload to**.
steps: Turn each place on or off.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › X
guides.title: What X charges for numbers
guides.answer: X charges a little for every number check. The checks stop at $10 a month, so X never costs more.

guides.title: Add a skill
guides.answer: In Skills, tap **Write a skill** and answer three easy questions. Or tap **Upload a file** to add a SKILL.md or a .zip with one inside.
steps: Tap **Write a skill**, or **Upload a file**.

guides.title: What a skill is
guides.answer: A skill teaches Clip Factory how you like your clips. All the AI in Clip Factory uses every skill, every time. To stop using one, open it and tap **Delete**. Built-in skills stay.
steps: Tap a skill to read it, edit it or delete it.

live.text: Skills Clip Factory uses right now: {value}.

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › Skills › Write a skill
guides.title: Make your own skill
guides.answer: Tap **Write a skill**. Answer the three questions: a name, when to use it, and what Clip Factory should do. Tap **Use the example** if you are stuck. Then tap **Save skill**.

guides.title: Edit a skill
guides.answer: Open **Skills** and tap the skill. Tap **Edit**, change the words, then tap **Save changes**. Built-in skills can be read, not changed.

guides.title: Delete a skill
guides.answer: To throw away a skill, open **Skills** and tap the skill. Tap **Delete**, then **Delete** again. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** at the bottom. Built-in skills cannot be deleted.

guides.title: Change the click sound
guides.answer: Pick your **Click sound** in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds. There are 30 to choose from. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Under **Click sound**, tap a card to hear it and pick it.

guides.title: Change the error sound
guides.answer: Pick your **Error sound** in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds. There are 30 to choose from. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Under **Error sound**, tap a card to hear it and pick it.

guides.title: Turn sounds off or on
guides.answer: Use the **Sounds** switch in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds to turn every sound off or on.

guides.title: Make it calmer: Reduce motion and Background
guides.answer: Turn on **Reduce motion** to stop confetti, page moves and the moving background. In **Background** you can pick plain **Colours** instead of the glass or a picture.

guides.title: See through the app, or pick a picture or colours
guides.answer: In **Background** pick **See-through**, **Picture** or **Colours**. See-through lets what is behind the window peek through the glass in the Mac and Windows app. Browsers and phones can't look behind the app, so there you get the Clip Factory colours.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Get the app for your computer
guides.answer: You can put Clip Factory on your computer like any other app. Open **Get the app** and tap the download button for your computer.
steps: Tap **Download for Mac** or **Download for Windows**.
If your Mac says it can't open it: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Open Anyway.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Add Clip Factory to your iPhone Home Screen
guides.answer: On iPhone and iPad, Clip Factory goes on your Home Screen from Safari.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Install Clip Factory on Android
guides.answer: On Android, your browser can install Clip Factory like any other app.
steps: Tap **Install app**. Some phones say **Add to Home screen**.

guides.title: Update the app
guides.answer: New versions arrive by themselves. When one is ready, a bar at the bottom says **New version ready**. Tap **Reload**.
steps: Wait for the **New version ready** bar, then tap **Reload**.
To look right now: tap **Settings**, **App & account**, **Updates**.

guides.title: When YouTube blocks a video
guides.answer: Sometimes YouTube blocks a video and asks to sign in. Then add your **YouTube cookies** in YouTube help and tap **Try again** on the job. You can skip this until it happens.
steps: Tap **Add cookies.txt** and pick the file.
Go to **Jobs** and tap **Try again** on the blocked job.

guides.title: How many clips each time, and the longest video
guides.answer: In **Clips** you set the fewest and most clips Clip Factory makes each time, and the **Longest video** it uses.
steps: Change **How many clips** with the buttons.

guides.title: Sign out
guides.answer: Tap **Sign out** in Settings › App & account › Account.

guides.title: Show Ask a picture
guides.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen. Take a screenshot, then paste it in Ask or drop it on Ask.
steps: Press **Cmd+Ctrl+Shift+4** and drag over the part of the screen you want.
Or drag a picture onto **Ask**, or tap **Add a picture**.

guides.title: Show Ask a picture
guides.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen. Take a screenshot, then paste it in Ask.
steps: Press **Win+Shift+S** and drag over the part of the screen you want.
Or drag a picture onto **Ask**, or tap **Add a picture**.

guides.title: Show Ask a picture
guides.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen, or a photo.
steps: Press the side button and the volume up button together to take a screenshot.
Pick your screenshot, or take a photo.

guides.title: What Clip Factory is
guides.answer: Clip Factory turns your long streams and videos into short clips. You check each clip, tap **Upload**, and it posts them for you.
steps: Paste a link on **Home** and tap **Make clips**.

guides.title: Find my clips and videos in Library
guides.answer: Every clip you uploaded is in **Library**. New clips you have not checked yet wait in **Review**.
steps: Tap a clip to see how it does.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Get the app on this computer
guides.answer: Your browser can put Clip Factory on this computer like any other app. Open **Get the app** and follow its steps.
steps: Follow the steps it shows for your browser.

guides.title: Turn on web search for Ask
guides.answer: Ask can read today's web pages once you add a free search key. Get it from Brave Search, paste it in **Settings › App & account › Ask** and tap **Save key**.
steps: Tap **Get a search key** and make a free account. Pick the **Search** plan.
Paste it under **Your search key** and tap **Save key**. A green check says web search is on.

guides.title: What Ask can do
guides.answer: Ask answers any question, not only about Clip Factory. It knows every page and setting, sees your own setup, can search the web and reads the files you add.
steps: Type any question, or add a file with the paperclip.
Tap the paper plane. The answer appears as it is written. Tap **Stop answer** to end it.

guides.title: Add files to Ask
guides.answer: Add files with the paperclip, drop them on Ask, or paste them. Ask reads pictures, PDFs, text files and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. It never keeps them.
steps: Tap the paperclip, or drag files onto Ask, or paste them.
Each file shows as a tile with its kind and name.
Ask your question and tap the paper plane.

guides.title: Mark a picture in red
guides.answer: Tap a picture in Ask's tray to mark it. Draw with **Pen**, **Box** or **Arrow** in red, then tap **Save**. Ask sees exactly what you marked.
steps: Pick **Pen**, **Box** or **Arrow** and draw on what you mean.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Content Rewards
guides.title: Connect Content Rewards
guides.answer: Content Rewards pays you for clips you make for brands. Connect it once, in 3 steps, in this order. 1: make a Content Rewards account, or tap **I have an account**. 2: add YouTube and your other accounts inside Content Rewards, then tap **I added them**. 3: on your Mac, tap **Connect Content Rewards** and allow it. Already set up there? Tap **Yes** at the top, then do step 3.
steps: Tap **Settings**, then **Posting**, then **Set up posting**, then **Content Rewards**.
Step 1: tap **Open Content Rewards** and make your account. Then tap **I have an account**.
Step 2: tap **Open Content Rewards settings** and add YouTube. Then tap **I added them**.
Step 3: on your Mac, tap **Connect Content Rewards** and allow it.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Content Rewards
guides.title: Content Rewards says my account can't connect apps
guides.answer: Content Rewards turns this on by email. On the Content Rewards page in Clip Factory, open **Content Rewards said no?**, tap **Open email** and send it from the email you sign in with. Until they say yes, you send each clip yourself and I remind you.
steps: Open the Content Rewards page in Set up posting.
When they say yes, tap **Connect Content Rewards** again.

guides.title: Add a Content Rewards campaign
guides.answer: Join the campaign on Content Rewards, tap its share icon, then **Copy campaign link**. In Clip Factory tap **Paste**, then **Add campaign**. I read the pay and the rules, and check by myself if you're in.
steps: Tap the share icon, then **Copy campaign link**.

guides.title: Am I in the campaign?
guides.answer: Clip Factory checks by itself and says **You're in!** on the campaign. To look yourself, open the campaign on Content Rewards: **Submit clip** means you're in, **Pending review** means you wait, **Not eligible** means the brand said no.
steps: Read the chip at the top: You're in, Waiting for the brand, or Not joined yet.

guides.title: I applied to a campaign. What now?
guides.answer: Nothing to do. On the campaign tap **Yes, I applied** if you like. Content Rewards shows **Pending review** while the brand decides, and I tell you when you're in.
steps: Open **Your campaigns** and tap the campaign.
Wait. I check by myself and tell you when you're in.

guides.title: Find campaigns that pay what I want
guides.answer: Tell me once what you want: how much it pays per 1,000 views, where you post, how much money is left and who can join. I look at Content Rewards' campaigns 4 times a day, skip ones Clip Factory can't make clips for, and tell you when new ones match. Every match has **Open on Content Rewards**. You join it there yourself.
steps: Open **Your campaigns** and tap **Find campaigns**. Or tap the **Find campaigns** chip on Home.
Pick **Pays at least**, **Where you post**, **Money left** and **Who can join**.
Wait a minute or two. The best matches come first.
To change it later, tap **Change**. It saves by itself.

guides.title: I found a campaign. How do I join it?
guides.answer: Tap **Open on Content Rewards** on the match, then **Join Campaign** there (or **Apply**, then **Submit application**). Come back and tap **I joined: add it**. No link to copy. Once Content Rewards lets Clip Factory sign in, I add it by myself when you come back and say You're in!
steps: On the match, tap **Open on Content Rewards**.
Tap **Join Campaign**. Does it say **Apply** instead? Tap **Apply**. Tick your accounts. Answer the questions. Tap **Submit application**.
Joined? Content Rewards shows **Submit clip**. Applied? It shows **Pending review**.
Joined, but Clip Factory isn't signed in to Content Rewards yet? Copy everything under **Brief** and **Content requirements**.
Come back to Clip Factory. Copied something? Paste it in the box. Tap **I joined: add it** or **I applied: add it**.
Once you're in, tap **Make clips for this campaign**.

guides.title: Why can't Clip Factory join campaigns for me?
guides.answer: Content Rewards has no way yet for apps to join or apply. Joining also means saying yes to the brand's rules, and only you can do that. A robot tapping for you would break Whop's rules and could hold back your money. So you tap **Join Campaign**, and I do the rest. Signed in? Tap **Ask Content Rewards** to ask them for a way.
steps: Near the bottom, find the card Clip Factory can't join for you. It shows once Clip Factory is signed in to Content Rewards.
Tap **Ask Content Rewards**. It sends one short note to their team.
To read the note first, tap **Show more**.

guides.title: A campaign isn't in Find campaigns
guides.answer: Open **Why not more?** under the matches. It says how many were left out, and why. Some pay too little or have too little money left. Others don't pay for your places, want you to apply or need what Clip Factory can't make. Tap **Change** and ask for less. Paused, ended and private campaigns never show. A new one can take a few hours, and the first few days I'm still looking at them all.
steps: Under the matches, open **Why not more?**.
Tap **Change** and pick less, like a lower **Pays at least**.
Said **Not for me** by mistake? Tap **Bring them back**.
Still not there? Tap **Look on Content Rewards yourself**.

guides.title: Add the campaign's logo
guides.answer: Some campaigns want their logo on every clip. On Content Rewards open **Reference materials** and download the logo. On the campaign in Clip Factory tap **Add the logo** and pick the file, or paste a Google Drive or Dropbox link.
steps: Download the file with logo in its name.
Open the campaign in Clip Factory.
Tap **Add the logo** and pick the file.

guides.title: Make campaign clips
guides.answer: Campaign clips start from a campaign: tap its chip in **Your campaigns** on Home, or tap **Make clips for this campaign** on the campaign. Home then says **Campaign clips** and its name. Paste or pick the video and tap **Make campaign clips**. The rules go with it: length, tags, #Ad and the logo.
steps: In **Your campaigns**, tap **Make campaign clips** on the campaign.
Tap a **Videos from the campaign** chip, or tap **Paste**.

guides.title: Normal clips or campaign clips?
guides.answer: There are two ways. **Make clips** on Home makes normal clips, the same as always. Campaign clips start from a campaign you joined: tap **Make campaign clips** on it in Your campaigns. Then Home says **Campaign clips** and its name. A normal clip that could earn on your campaign tells you so on Review.
steps: Normal clips: on **Home**, tap **Paste**, then **Make clips**.
Campaign clips: in **Your campaigns** on Home, tap **Make campaign clips**.
Look at the top: it says **Campaign clips** and the campaign's name.
Back to normal clips? Tap **Make normal clips instead**.

guides.title: Can this clip earn on my campaign?
keywords: can this clip earn on my campaign
will this clip get paid on content rewards
guides.answer: On Review, a campaign clip checks its Content Rewards rules. It checks the length, where it pays, tags and #Ad, the logo, Paid partnership, where the video is from, its language, banned things and the deadline. If it can't earn money, **Upload** stays off. **Wait a little** means Upload turns on by itself. **I couldn't check** means look yourself. One clip earns on one campaign only.
steps: Tap **Review**. Read the big line under **Campaign clip** at the top.
**Almost ready** or **One thing first**? Tap the button right under it.
**Needs a copy of this clip**? Tap **Make a FaZe Clips copy**.
**Can't earn**? Tap **Make new clips for this campaign**.
**Check 2 things**? Read them. You can still tap **Upload**.

guides.title: What does Fix it for me do?
keywords: what does fix it for me do
guides.answer: On a campaign clip, when a caption is missing #Ad or a tag the campaign wants, Review says so and shows **Fix it for me**. Tap it to put them back in the words right now. Tap **Undo** within 8 seconds to get the old words back. You don't have to tap it: when the clip uploads, I put #Ad and the tags back by myself. For TikTok, **Turn on Branded content** is its own button. Tap that one yourself.
steps: Find the line that says #Ad or a tag is missing.
Tap **Fix it for me**. The words have them again.
Tap **Undo** if you want the old words back.
Or skip it: I put them back when it uploads.

guides.title: Make a campaign copy of a clip
keywords: use this clip for my campaign
guides.answer: When a normal clip could earn on a campaign you're in, Review says **This clip could earn money on** it. Tap the button with the campaign's name, like **Make a FaZe Clips copy**. In about 3 minutes the copy shows right below, with the logo, **Paid partnership** and #Ad. Upload the copy to earn. The first clip stays as it is. **Not now** hides the line.
steps: In **Review**, find **This clip could earn money on** under the clip.
Tap **Make a FaZe Clips copy**. It shows your campaign's name.
Wait about 3 minutes. The copy shows right below.
On the copy, tap **Use my settings**, then **Upload**.
You can throw the first one away.
Already posted the normal way? Content Rewards only takes a post in its first 30 minutes, so make a copy.

guides.title: Why is TikTok left out for campaigns?
guides.answer: Campaign clips skip TikTok for now: your Mac can't mark them as Branded content yet. So campaign clips go to YouTube, Instagram, X and Facebook for now.
steps: Set up YouTube, Instagram, X or Facebook.
Pick campaigns that pay for those places.

guides.title: Did my clip go to Content Rewards?
guides.answer: Each campaign clip has a line under its posts: **Sent** means Content Rewards has it and the brand will check it, **Approved** means it counts. Find it in Library, on the clip, or on the campaign.

guides.title: Send a clip to Content Rewards myself
guides.answer: When I can't send a clip, its line says **Send this to Content Rewards now**. Tap **Copy and open**, tap **Submit clip**, paste in **Clip link**, tick the box and tap **Submit clip**. Do it within 30 minutes of posting.
steps: Tap **Copy and open** on the clip's line.

guides.title: The brand wants proof of views
guides.answer: Some brands ask for a screen recording of a clip's views. When it's due, the clip's line says so and I send a notification. Open the clip's views, record your screen, send it to the brand, then tap **I sent it**.
steps: Open the clip's views (YouTube Studio, Instagram, X or Facebook).
Record your screen while they show.
Send it where the brief says, or in Content Rewards **Support**.

guides.title: My campaign clip was not approved
keywords: brand said no to my clip
guides.answer: The clip's line shows what the brand said. If you think it follows the rules, tap **Ask again**: it copies the words and opens Content Rewards. Tap **Rejected**, the clip, **Start appeal**, paste and tap **Start appeal**.
steps: Tap **Ask again** on the clip's line.

guides.title: Get my Content Rewards money
guides.answer: Money from approved campaign clips shows on **Money** under Content Rewards, in Content Rewards' own numbers. When **Ready to move** has $1 or more, move it to Whop on Content Rewards, then from Whop to your bank.
steps: Answer: do you see **Finance** in the Content Rewards menu?
Follow the steps: move it to Whop, then to your bank.

guides.title: What is Whop?
guides.answer: Whop is the website where Content Rewards sends your money. From there it goes to your bank. Link your Whop account inside Content Rewards once, then add your bank on Whop.
steps: Follow **Link your Whop account** and **Add your bank on Whop**.

guides.title: How do I set up getting paid?
guides.answer: Open **Get paid**. It has one card for each place that can pay you: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and Content Rewards. Tap a card and do its steps in order. Each place pays you on its own pages, so Clip Factory never asks for your bank, card or tax numbers. Each card says if money can reach you, and how Clip Factory knows.
steps: Tap the red button. It opens the place's own page.
Do the step there. Come back and tap **I did this**. Some steps tick themselves.
Some steps wait for the place, like a letter or your first money. The step says when.
On **Money**, the **Get paid** card shows every place too.

guides.title: What does Can get paid mean?
keywords: what does can get paid mean
guides.answer: It means money can reach you from that place. **Can get paid ✓ (YouTube says)**: the place itself told Clip Factory. **Can get paid (you said it's done)**: you ticked every step, but that place doesn't tell apps. What a place says always beats your ticks. With no sign and no tick, Clip Factory never says a place is ready.
steps: **Not set up yet**: you can earn there, but a payout step isn't done. Tap the red button.
**Not set up (YouTube says)**, in red: the place says something is missing. Tap the red button.
**Payment on hold**: the place is holding your money. Tap the red button to see why.
**Not allowed yet**: you don't reach the place's rules yet. Clip Factory tells you when you do.
**Clip Factory can't check**: it can't see that place. You can still do its steps.
**Checking…**: the first check can take until tomorrow. **Not started**: do the steps.

guides.title: How much was sent to my bank?
keywords: sent to your bank so far
guides.answer: Google and Whop tell Clip Factory what they sent. On **Money**, **All your money** shows it under each place, and **Sent to your bank, so far** has one total for each money type, never added together. TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X don't tell apps: **Not available**. To see what arrived, look in your bank's app, or in **Your bank** once it is set up.
steps: Tap **Money**. Find **Sent to your bank, so far** under **All your money**.
Under each place in **All your money**, a small line says what that place sent so far, like **Sent to your bank by Google**.
Google's money reaches your bank up to 7 workdays after Google sends it. Whop says when.
To see each payment, open **Get paid** and tap **YouTube** or **Content Rewards**.
Whop counts all your Whop money, not only Content Rewards.
YouTube needs **Allow payment reading** first. Whop needs **Connect Whop**.

guides.title: Get paid by YouTube
guides.answer: Join the YouTube Partner Program in YouTube Studio. That makes your **AdSense for YouTube**, Google's page that pays you. Then add your US tax info and your bank, confirm a tiny test payment, check your ID and type the PIN from a letter. In Sweden YouTube pays in kronor straight to your bank, between the 21st and 26th, once you have kr 700.
steps: Step 1: join the Partner Program. It ticks itself when YouTube says you're in.
Optional: a grown-up taps **Allow payment reading** on the Mac. Then Clip Factory sees holds and payments.
Steps 2 to 6 open **AdSense for YouTube**. Do each one when YouTube lets you.
Tap **I did this** on each. Google's first payment ticks them for you.

guides.title: Can I earn on TikTok in Sweden?
guides.answer: Not from Creator Rewards: TikTok lists only the US, UK, Germany, Japan, South Korea, France, Mexico and Brazil. **Video Gifts** and **LIVE Gifts** may work in Sweden, so look in **TikTok Studio**. Gifts need you to be 18 or older with a Personal account. TikTok pays to PayPal, your bank or Payoneer. TikTok doesn't tell apps what you earn.
steps: Do these in the TikTok app on your phone.
Step 1: tap **Profile**, the menu ☰, **TikTok Studio**, **Video Gifts**, then **Turn on Gifts**.
Step 2: tap **Profile**, ☰, **Balance**, then **LIVE rewards**. Pick PayPal, your bank or Payoneer.
Tap **I did this** after each step. TikTok doesn't tell Clip Factory.

guides.title: Why won't X pay for my clips?
guides.answer: X's Original Content Rewards leaves out posts made or posted by automated means, and reuploaded or barely changed clips. So your Clip Factory clips probably won't earn on X. It also needs a paid plan (not Basic), 500 verified followers and 500,000 views from verified people in 90 days. Creator Revenue Sharing ended in September 2026.
steps: Read the warning at the top of the page.
Only buy **Premium** if you also post your own videos.
Apply in **Creator Studio**, under **Original Content Rewards**.
X pays through Stripe every two weeks once you have $30.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Get paid › Content Rewards
guides.title: See my Whop payouts
keywords: sent to your bank by whop
guides.answer: The Content Rewards page in **Get paid** has the card **See your Whop payouts here**. Make your own Whop key once on Whop's developer page, paste it in **Whop key** and tap **Save key**, then **Connect Whop**. Clip Factory only reads what Whop sent. It never moves money. Until this is switched on, the card says **Coming soon**.
steps: Tap **Open Whop's developer page**. Follow the card: **Create app**, then copy the **Client ID**.
Paste it in **Whop key**. Tap **Save key**.
Tap **Connect Whop** and allow it on Whop.
**Sent to your bank by Whop** counts all your Whop money, not only Content Rewards.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Get paid › Your bank
guides.title: How do I see what reached my bank?
keywords: see my bank in clip factory
guides.answer: Open **Get paid**, then **Your bank**. Do its steps once, in order: make a free Enable Banking account, tap **Make my bank key**, add Clip Factory there, give Clip Factory the app ID, link your accounts, then tap **Connect your bank** and use BankID. Clip Factory never sees your bank login. Until this is switched on, the card says Clip Factory can't see your bank.
steps: Tap the red button on each step. It opens Enable Banking, or does the step for you.
Step 2: tap **Make my bank key**. Step 3: copy it into Enable Banking.
Step 5: paste the app ID and tap **Save**.
Step 7: tap **Connect your bank**, pick your bank and use BankID.
It takes about 25 minutes, once, and it's free.

guides.title: How much reached my bank?
guides.answer: Until **Your bank** is set up, look in your bank's app. Once it is, Clip Factory reads what your bank booked, once a day. On **Money**, **Reached your bank, so far** shows what each app paid in, one total for each money type, never added together. YouTube and Whop payments are matched to their own records. For the others you tap once to say which app paid.
steps: Tap **Money**. Find **Reached your bank, so far** under **Sent to your bank, so far**.
Each app has its own line, then **In total**.
Instagram and Facebook can be one line: Meta pays them in one payment.
Payments that need you: tap **Answer them**.
Each app's page in **Get paid** also shows its own line.
Until **Your bank** is set up, Clip Factory can't see your bank: look in your bank's app.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Get paid › Your bank
guides.title: Is this money from an app?
keywords: is this money from an app
did you move this from your paypal
guides.answer: When your bank gets money that may be from an app, **Your bank** asks you. Tap the green answer, like **Yes, it's YouTube**. Another app? Tap **No, another app** and pick it. Not app money? Tap **Not money from an app**. You never type an amount. Clip Factory remembers a payer you confirm, so it asks less next time.
steps: Tap the green answer, or **No, another app** and pick the app.
Stripe, PayPal and Payoneer pay for many apps, so Clip Factory asks each time.
Tapped the wrong one? Tap **Undo**, or **Not from YouTube?** under **Reached your bank**.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Get paid › Your bank
guides.title: Why does my bank link end?
keywords: why does my bank link end
guides.answer: Your bank lets an app read it for 90 to 180 days. Then it asks for BankID again. Clip Factory tells you 7 days before. Tap **Reconnect** and use BankID at your bank. The money it found stays. A bank can also end a link early. Then **Your bank** says so and shows **Reconnect** too.
steps: Under **Your banks**, each bank shows how many days are left.
Tap the red **Reconnect** button. Use BankID at your bank.
**Stop reading** stops one bank. The money it found stays.
**Look in your bank app**: your bank wants you to do something there first.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Get paid › Your bank
guides.title: What does Clip Factory keep from my bank?
keywords: does clip factory see my bank login
guides.answer: Only money from apps: the day, the amount and which app. Never your account number, your name or any other payment. Your bank and PayPal logins stay with them, and Clip Factory never sees them. Enable Banking forgets your bank's answer within a minute. **Forget my bank** removes every payment and bank link Clip Factory kept.
steps: Payments it asks you about stay until you answer, at most 180 days.
To remove it all, tap **Forget my bank**. You have 8 seconds to tap **Undo**.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Get paid › Your bank
guides.title: Is Enable Banking free for me?
guides.answer: Yes, for your own private use. Enable Banking lets Clip Factory read your own bank with BankID. It's free for a private person's own accounts. Its terms don't allow business use, so it's your choice: the first step has a ready email that asks them if your app money counts. Never tap **Request activation**: that one costs money.
steps: Optional first step: tap **Open email**, then send it. Then tap **I asked**.
Use only your own private accounts. Pick **personal**.
If they say no, tap **Forget my bank**. Your bank's app still shows what arrived.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Content Rewards
guides.title: Sign in to Content Rewards again
guides.answer: Content Rewards keeps you signed in for up to 90 days. A week before, I remind you. Open the Content Rewards page on your Mac and tap **Connect again**. It takes one minute.
